answer: At payout, each identity opens its oyster at the haven, and the quill records the pearl inside. Every identity backs its claim with a 1,300,000 POA stake. A pearl found in two oysters belongs to one operator: both rewards burn, both stakes pass to honest peers, and the operator pays a 700,000 POA fine per fake. One fake costs 2,000,000 POA, and four fakes cost 8,000,000 POA before any payout clears.
